nodes.author: mabian
nodes.text:
The most obvious explanation for the sharp rise in infections by so many different pathogens could very well be because most people have already been infected with the SARS-CoV-2 virus, that’s the virus that causes the disease Covid-19. 

This virus remains inside your immune system, mainly T Cells, and exhausts them. This opens the door to infections that, if you didn’t get COVID, would have been fought off successfully. 

Covid is much more dangerous than people seem to think. And, so far, we haven’t even seen the disease it’s going to cause. We only saw people die from the reaction to being inoculated. Just like HIV the disease won’t appear for 10 years or whenever.

nodes.author: mabian
nodes.text:
Right. And we saw Bird Flu start about 30 years ago. Very slowly (because viruses have all the time in the world) this virus, the H5N1, went from almost exclusively infecting Corvids (Crows, Jays, Ravens) to other birds.

Then it jumped to sea mammals and killed many thousands. Then land mammals, then cows, cats, etc.

Finally it got into humans. The cow type not so serious so far; the bird type did kill a child in Canada and a man in Louisiana. Both had other risk factors. 

But H5N1 has lots of time and we have no world leadership trying to take the simple steps to stop it. IMHO
